name: SHG-based Volumetric Display
aliases: Volumetric display via frequency upconversion (SHG) with laser scanning
definition: A physical volumetric display technique that creates 3D objects by scanning a focused femtosecond laser beam through a transparent composite containing dispersed nonlinear optical crystals, generating visible light via second-harmonic generation (SHG) localized at the focal point.
summary: SHG-based Volumetric Display creates 3D images by scanning a laser through nonlinear crystals to generate visible light via second-harmonic generation, eliminating ghost images through instantaneous emission.
